# Open Payments fixture provenance

Official bounded excerpts captured November 13, 2026 from the CMS Open Payments
DKAN API for Program Year 2024, June 30, 2026 publication
`P06302026_06032026`. No third-party parser code is copied.

The fixture keeps the selected catalog datasets and one literal source row plus
its returned schema/count for each summary level. Tests explicitly replace the
count and request coordinates when constructing a synthetic complete population.
Those synthetic populations do not establish complete source acceptance.

Exact original paths, SHA-256 values, request URLs and observation times are in
`output/source-completion-20261113/lanes/cms-open-payments/catalog.json` and
`year-controls.json` in the Spicy stack workspace. Originals live in the central
raw archive and the bounded visual review is retained in that lane. Counts are
publisher observations for those captures, not permanent dataset facts.
